── Deep Analysis ───────────────────────────────────────
One position, opened 06:25, and the only question that matters is
whether it arms. BLUR LONG entered at 0.008182 mid-range while the
coin had printed a flat 2h band 0.00816-0.00822 and BTC sat below
EMA300 — structurally a chop entry, the profile that feeds
hard_max_loss. I would NOT open this fresh: we bought the middle of
a range against a bear macro tape, and BLUR's own 30d book is 6W/-0.56.

What keeps it alive is arithmetic, not conviction. Trail-family
trades are the only thing that has paid: 24h trailed 11T 9W +0.88 vs
untrailed 9T 0W -0.96 (every untrailed trade in 24h lost); 7d trailed
54T 41W +3.09 vs untrailed 66T 7W -4.26. BLUR has already touched the
+0.40% arm line (0.008215) at T+22m, ahead of the 45m pump-chain
trail-arm timeout — if it arms, it converts from chop inventory into
the 86.5% cohort; if it fades back under entry, the range ceiling
rejected us and we are the wrong side. Hence one exit condition and
one hold condition instead of a vague "monitor".

Throughput is still the binding constraint on everything else: the
hotset has been empty through cycles 10158-10160 and the queue loses
signals to three different gates in the same cycle (RSI floor, RR
hard block, RSI ceiling). Capital that cannot deploy is capital
earning nothing — the opportunity cost of the last flat window was
SOPH -2.6%, REZ +2.4%, ZORA +2.2%, XAI +2.2%.

1. BLUR #16378: exit on any 5m close < 0.008182; hold only while
   >=0.008215. Verify trailing_activated next cycle — if price holds
   >=+0.40% and the trail still has not armed, escalate the known
   candle-vs-poll arming gap (execution item #17, do not re-tune exits).
2. Do not add LONG fills while BTC 1m holds below EMA300 ~80832;
   that objection retracts automatically on a 15-30m held close above.
   Re-test the level next cycle, do not inherit this sentence.
3. Escalate starvation #7 with this cycle's gate names (floor / RR
   block / ceiling) — band alignment is brain-auditor territory, not

4. When picks resume, prefer SHORT setups at RSI 55-65 (7d 4T 2W
   +0.47) and avoid the 45-55 mid-band (7d 8T 2W -0.18) that the
   current pick guidance calls the sweet spot.
5. ATOM SHORT stays a manual watchlist reference — never report it
   as FIRED while AI_TRADER_ENABLED=False.
